```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
monona = read_csv("../../data/lake-monona-winters-2024.csv")
model = lm(duration~year1, monona)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
# 95% Confidence interval for beta_1
pe = -0.22298 
cv = qt(0.975, 169-2)
se = 0.02667

pe + c(-1,1)*cv*se
```


```{r}
# 5% significance level hypothesis testing

t = pe/se
t
p_val = pt(t, 169-2)
p_val
alpha = 0.05

2*pt(t, 169-2)
```

```{r}
t = (pe-1)/se
t

pt(t, 167)
pt(t, 167, lower.tail = F)
```


```{r}
# 95% prediction interval

predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "prediction")
```

```{r}

# 95% Confidence interval
predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "confidence")
```
